<!-- Release: v0.15.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Uses the same development signing key as earlier releases; install over your existing development build.

## Changes

- A continuous frosted Queue drawer, with matching directional return buttons in queues and lyrics
- Smoother player transitions and artwork changes, shared cover-loading animations, and circular artist artwork
- Plain-language playback failure popups, plus Library filter/sort fixes and a softer scrolling edge

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/54 - Continuous frosted Queue drawer
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/64 - Directional queue and lyric return buttons
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/69 - Artwork restored during held lyric collapse
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/70 - Coordinated player metadata and control fades
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/71 - Retained artwork and friendly playback failures
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/72 - Shared artwork loading and quick reveal
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/73 - Circular Artist and Album Artist covers
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/76 - Atomic Library filter sorting and top-edge fade

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.15.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it on Android and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Tap **Install** or **Update**. Keep the existing app installed to retain your library and settings.
